name: Ii Futami
source:
Saku’s self-proclaimed wife. Appearing on day one in [url=/c468]Saku's[/url] house, she is a frank, straight girl that is good with housekeeping. While very knowledgeable, she lacks a bit of common sense. Her nickname at school, the Super Saintly Sister, perhaps describes her the best. She represents Gemini.

[from [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/01/24/itsuka-todoku-ano-sora-ni-review/]warum's review[/url].]

[spoiler]Her real surname is 雲戌亥 (Kumoinui), which Saku is unable to perceive correctly at first.[/spoiler]
